column3: “Takes effect” interprets the decree giving birth.
“Restore their captives” renders turn back their captivity.
“When” replaces for; in its own place replaces from his place.
The final third-person they is absorbed into the direct address.
Creatures of every kind replaces every animal of a nation; screech owl renders the hedgehog, and their calls specifies a singular voice.
“Carefree” renders jubilant; thinks replaces says, and fist specifies hand.
